description: This file defines a custom ASP.NET Core action filter attribute called ValidateModelAttribute, which intercepts controller actions to verify the validity of the incoming model state and returns a 400 Bad Request response with validation error details if validation fails.

classes.name: ValidateModelAttribute
classes.description: A sealed class inheriting from ActionFilterAttribute, used to validate the model state before executing a controller action.

methods.name: OnActionExecuting
methods.description: Overrides the base method to check if the model state is valid; if not, sets the result to a 400 Bad Request with validation details.
